DEVDUO IDE: THE ULTIMATE AI CODE EDITOR & MOBILE IDE

Transform your Android device into a professional development workstation with DevDuo IDE, the most advanced AI code editor and mobile IDE designed for the modern programmer. Whether you are a student learning Python, a web developer crafting HTML/CSS, or a professional engineer debugging on the go, DevDuo IDE is your pocket-sized command center.

WHY CHOOSE DEVDUO AI CODE EDITOR?
In 2026, coding on mobile shouldn't feel limited. DevDuo IDE evolves beyond a simple code viewer to provide a complete integrated development environment. Experience desktop-grade performance with a "Futuristic Neon" interface optimized for speed and precision.

CORE FEATURES:

1. DEVDUO AI CODING ASSISTANT
Leverage the power of the latest AI models directly in your editor.
• Smart Coding Companion: Stuck on a logic bug? Ask the AI assistant for instant debugging and explanations.
• AI Code Generation: Create entire files from simple prompts like “Build a responsive login screen in Flutter.”
• Auto-Fix & Refactor: Automatically optimize your code, fix syntax errors, and add professional comments with one tap.

2. POWERFUL CLOUD COMPILER & RUNTIME
Execute your scripts instantly without heavy local processing.
• Multi-Language Support: A robust Python compiler, Java compiler, and C++ runner in one app.
• Real-Time Console: View standard output (stdout) and errors in a resizable, dedicated console window.
• Secure Sandbox: Your code runs in a secure, temporary environment and is deleted immediately after execution for total privacy.

3. PRO-LEVEL CODE EDITOR TOOLS
Built by developers, for developers.
• Syntax Highlighting: Perfect visual clarity for 100+ languages including JavaScript, Dart, Kotlin, Swift, Go, Rust, and SQL.
• Desktop Workflow: Multi-tab editing, line numbers, word wrap, auto-indentation, and powerful Find & Replace.
• Web Preview Mode: Craft websites with a built-in split-screen preview for HTML, CSS, and JS projects.

4. CUSTOMIZATION & PRODUCTIVITY
• 15+ Pro Themes: Personalize your workspace with Dracula, Monokai, GitHub Dark, and more.
• Smart File Management: Seamlessly access device storage, organize project folders, and manage scratchpads.
• History & Recovery: Never lose work with automatic session saving and AI conversation history.

SUPPORTED FORMATS:
• Core: Python 3, Java, C, C++, C#, Dart, Swift, Kotlin.
• Web: HTML5, CSS3, SCSS, JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, PHP.
• Data & Scripting: SQL, JSON, YAML, Go, Rust, Ruby, Bash, Shell, PowerShell, Markdown, and 100+ more.

PRIVACY FIRST:
Your code belongs to you. DevDuo IDE works locally on your device, ensuring your intellectual property remains private and secure.

Join thousands of developers using the #1 AI code editor to build the future. Download DevDuo IDE today and code anywhere!
